PS Nest 1.4.0 — Custom separation cuts

Nest your parts, then choose Edit separation cuts above the sheet preview.

  • Draw a cut between sheet edges. Click extra corners for stepped paths.
  • Drag a line or its white handles. Undo, delete or reset to automatic.
  • Unsafe cuts turn red and cannot be saved. Valid cuts are green.
  • Save cuts to update the DXF, applicable cutting PDF and layout files.
  • Saved jobs retain the paths. Nesting again rechecks their clearance.

Custom cuts are for sheets. Their reusable offcut area is not yet measured. Existing automatic modes remain available.
